title: Launch at Deptford Dockyard
creator: John Cleveley the Elder
credit: Science Museum Group Collection / © The Board of Trustees of the Science Museum
alt: Oil painting of Deptford Dockyard, with a warship at the dock on the left, ships at anchor, and small boats on the Thames.
chapter_connection: Chapters III–IV: Equiano joins the Preston at Deptford and is later taken off the Aetna there and sold to Captain Doran. The painting is a view of the dockyard, not an illustration of either episode.
reproduction_note: Downloaded museum-provided JPEG, unchanged; no crop or enhancement.

title: A view of Louisburg in North America, taken near the light house when that city was besieged in 1758
creator: Pierre Charles Canot, engraver, after Captain Ince of the 35th Regiment
collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division
rights: No known restrictions on publication (Library of Congress rights advisory); eighteenth-century public-domain work.
credit: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division, LC-USZ62-2771
alt: Black-and-white etching looking across Louisbourg harbor from rocky ground near a lighthouse, with sailing ships and the fortified town in the distance.
chapter_connection: Chapter III: Equiano serves aboard the Namur in the 1758 expedition against Louisbourg. This is a later print of the setting, not a depiction of Equiano.
reproduction_note: Downloaded library-provided JPEG, unchanged; scan from black-and-white film copy negative.
